Next was to rule out whether it's primary or secondary amyloidosis.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAmyloidosis is a heterogeneous disease that results from the deposition of toxic insoluble beta-sheet fibrillar protein aggregates in different tissues. Amyloidosis can be acquired or hereditary. The disease can be localized or systemic. Amyloid can accumulate in the liver, spleen, kidney, heart, nerves, and blood vessels, causing different clinical syndromes, including cardiomyopathy, hepatomegaly, proteinuria, macroglossia, autonomic dysfunction, ecchymoses, neuropathy, renal failure, hypertension, and corneal and vitreous abnormalities.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPreviously multiple classification systems have been devised to classify different types of amyloidosis. In modern times it has been classified according to the chemical analysis of amyloid clinical entities. Amyloidosis can be classified according to systemic, hereditary, central nervous system, ocular, and localized etiology. However, the most common types are AL, AA, ATTR (amyloid transport protein transthyretin), and dialysis-related amyloidosis (beta2M type).\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn AL amyloidosis, 'A' represents amyloid followed by the associated fibrillar protein, 'L' means light chain fragment or immunoglobulin light chain. In AA amyloidosis, the second A stands for the serum amyloid A protein.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/books\/NBK470285\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/books\/NBK470285\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInvestigations done to detect evidence of monoclonal plasma cell disorder :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1) SIEP ( Serum immuno-electrophoresis ) - Negative for monoclonal protein.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2) SFLC - ( Serum free light chain ) = 2.66\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESerum Kappa light chain - 441\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESerum lambda light chain - 165.5\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3) ESR - 35 mm\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4) Bone marrow aspiration - Reactive marrow with plasmacytosis . Mild increase -12 to 15 % plasma cells .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOther investigations :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC3\/C4 - 93\/77\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EANA \/ANCA\/DS DNA = negative\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnti CCP = negative\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnti cardiolipin and beta 2 glycoprotein = negative.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECAUSES FOR SECONDARY AMYLOIDOSIS:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEjMkdcqENgm11TZuHgOYff_DPmE5gVCOIQZ-BPWlH8FnSDEVnS4g2JeD1qODTjolMvB_4P8IV6i6r0CdwYYWi154ADap0MWngtysExRdM5nFRQj5b6L6u0HUDq02lj5PuwxxZSxvkehKRRQiyC4TM6TBei_YZQ30c4NRZ6nPzYozHKU2VQNSCeTEN-A_g\/s1080\/Screenshot_20220921-195206__01.jpg\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"951\" data-original-width=\"1080\" height=\"282\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEjMkdcqENgm11TZuHgOYff_DPmE5gVCOIQZ-BPWlH8FnSDEVnS4g2JeD1qODTjolMvB_4P8IV6i6r0CdwYYWi154ADap0MWngtysExRdM5nFRQj5b6L6u0HUDq02lj5PuwxxZSxvkehKRRQiyC4TM6TBei_YZQ30c4NRZ6nPzYozHKU2VQNSCeTEN-A_g\/s320\/Screenshot_20220921-195206__01.jpg\" width=\"320\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient gives no history of joint pains ,rashes ,oral ulcers ,hair loss .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInvestigations for secondary amyloidosis:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1) HRCT chest :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERight moderate pleural effusion\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWith collapse of middle lobe with left mild pleural effusion .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAtelectatic bands in right middle lobe\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECardiomegaly with LA ,LV enlargement.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2) Mantoux test -
